d: The Russia-Ukraine war is entering another tense phase. Ukraine and Russia have reported cyberattacks on their emergency alert systems, spreading fake warnings of nuclear radiation and chemical threats. A six-day humanitarian ceasefire in the occupied town of Oleshky has ended, while Ukraine has resumed strikes on Russian oil refineries and Russia continues to target Ukraine's energy infrastructure. Washington is pushing for fresh peace talks in Abu Dhabi and has approved a potential $2.1 billion Patriot missile deal for Kyiv. But with the fighting continuing and key details of the talks…
